title: Whether new laws or actions are planned to curb criminal use of Telegram
asked: Mr Vikram Nair asked whether the Ministry plans further laws, regulations or actions to curb Telegram's use for illicit activity, naming drug, vape and etomidate sales, scam operations and sexual crimes.
response: Mr Goh Pei Ming said the Government mainly uses powers under the Online Criminal Harms Act (OCHA), under which OCHA Directions can stop offending accounts or content from interacting with users in Singapore, and the Police have disrupted online criminal activity including on Telegram. Under the OCHA Codes of Practice, designated services such as Telegram must put in place systems and processes to quickly disrupt malicious accounts and activity. The Police are working with designated providers, including Telegram, to implement further anti-scam measures under the Codes by this year, and the Government will keep reviewing its laws and regulations.

key_points.point: The Government's main legal tool against criminal misuse of online platforms is the Online Criminal Harms Act.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Government primarily relies on the legal powers under the Online Criminal Harms Act (OCHA)

key_points.point: OCHA Directions can stop offending accounts or content from interacting with users in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Government can issue OCHA Directions to prevent the offending accounts or content from interacting with users in Singapore

key_points.point: Since OCHA began operating, the Police have disrupted online criminal activity, including on Telegram, more effectively.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Police have been able to disrupt online criminal activities, including on communication platforms, such as Telegram, more effectively

key_points.point: Under the OCHA Codes of Practice, designated services such as Telegram must implement systems and processes to quickly disrupt malicious accounts and activity.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: designated online services, such as Telegram, must implement appropriate systems, processes and measures to quickly disrupt malicious accounts and activities

key_points.point: The Police are working with designated providers, including Telegram, to bring in further anti-scam measures under the Codes by this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Police are working with designated online service providers, including Telegram, to implement further anti-scam measures under the OCHA Codes of Practice by this year

key_points.point: The Government will keep reviewing its laws and regulations for effectiveness in protecting users in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: The Government will continue to review our laws and regulations to ensure that they remain effective in protecting users in Singapore from online criminal harms

key_points.point: A key trait of Telegram is that users can remain anonymous, unlike WhatsApp.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: One of the key traits of Telegram is that users can remain anonymous

key_points.point: Follow-ups through the Central Narcotics Bureau found that many drug and sexual offers on Telegram are scams posing as such offers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: many of these offers to sell drugs, even sexual offers, are actually scams masquerading as those offers

key_points.point: The fall in overall victim numbers and amounts lost continued into the first quarter of this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: In the first quarter of this year, the numbers have continued that trend

key_points.point: Further anti-scam measures are coming later this year, and MHA is reviewing its internal organisation for fighting scams.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: More details will be released when ready

left_open: Whether the additional measures will effectively reduce the number of crimes facilitated on Telegram.
Measures aimed specifically at the sale of vapes and etomidate on Telegram.
Measures aimed specifically at sexual crimes on Telegram, beyond the framing of such offers as scams.
supplementary: Whether the added measures will effectively cut crimes on Telegram, given the platform's anonymity.
